title: Missed Readings alert uses same sound as Forecasted Low
symptom: When you choose a sound for Forecasted Low Alerts, the same sound is used for Missed Readings Alerts. Users cannot select independent sounds for these alerts, and also cannot set separate sounds for BG Falling Fast and BG Rising Fast.
cause: The thread identifies that the Missed Readings alert takes its sound setting from the BG Falling Fast alert, and there is a single setting for both BG Falling Fast and BG Rising Fast sounds.
evidence_quote: Actually, it might be BG Falling Fast alert sound that is overriding the Missed Readings Alert.
